label: History
value: Owen Ford becomes acquainted with Gilbert Blythe while staying near the lighthouse.
unit: Owen Ford arrives at Four Winds Light seeking a quiet, inspiring location to recover his health and write a novel. While staying near the lighthouse, he becomes acquainted with Anne Shirley Blythe, Gilbert Blythe, Captain Jim Boyd, and Leslie Moore. Upon hearing Captain Jim recount his colorful sea-faring life and lost loves, Owen realizes that Captain Jim's life story is the great novel he himself has been trying to invent. With Captain Jim's permission, Owen transcribes and adapts the captain's 'life book' into a novel entitled 'The Life-Book of Captain Jim.' During his stay, Owen falls deeply in love with Leslie Moore, whose tragic life and beauty captivate him. After Leslie is freed from her tragic situation and her identity crisis is resolved, Owen woos her and eventually proposes. Their collaborative efforts and mutual devotion lead to a happy engagement, and Owen's book becomes a major literary success.

label: History
value: Gilbert proposed to Anne.
unit: Gilbert Blythe returned to Avonlea School as a teenager and immediately sparked a multi-year rivalry with Anne Shirley after playfully mocking her red hair. Despite his repeated efforts to apologize and become friends, Anne refused to speak to him for years, driving both of them to excel academically. Their academic rivalry culminated in a tie for the Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy. After graduation, Gilbert gallantly gave up the Avonlea schoolteaching position to Anne so she could remain at Green Gables after Matthew Cuthbert's death, which finally earned him her friendship. During their time at Redmond College, Gilbert fell deeply in love with Anne and proposed to her, but she initially rejected him, believing she did not love him in that way. Following a near-fatal bout of typhoid fever after college, Gilbert's illness forced Anne to realize her true feelings for him. Once recovered, he proposed again and was accepted. After completing medical school, Gilbert married Anne in the orchard at Green Gables and moved with her to the 'House of Dreams' at Four Winds Harbor to establish his medical practice. In Four Winds, Gilbert earns the respect of the local community, including the cynical Captain Jim and the aloof Leslie Moore. He and Anne face tragic heartbreak when their firstborn child, Joyce, dies shortly after birth, but their marriage endures, and they later welcome a healthy son named Little Jem.

value: Anne decided to stay in Avonlea to support Marilla.
unit: Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, unmarried life at Green Gables with her bachelor brother Matthew. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to help Matthew with farm work, they were mistakenly sent an imaginative girl named Anne Shirley. Though initially determined to return Anne, Marilla quickly relented and agreed to keep and raise her. Over the years, Marilla provided a grounded, disciplined upbringing while gradually warming to Anne's passionate nature and coming to love her deeply. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the threat of losing her eyesight and considered selling Green Gables, but Anne decided to stay in Avonlea to support her. Marilla later took in the orphaned twins Davy and Dora Keith, distant relatives of hers, navigating the challenges of raising the mischievous Davy. As Anne went on to attend college and eventually marry Gilbert Blythe, Marilla remained at Green Gables as a beloved matriarch figure, taking great joy in Anne's visits and new family.
